My dear[ Gertrude](../persons.html#1462)
Thank you for your letter, which I found here when I arrived yesterday, by way of Salisbury and Basingstoke. I meant all those flowers of which there was but one specimen for you, [Helen](../persons.html#1613) may wait to collect for herself
Your most affectionate

C M Yonge

[^1]: Dated on the assumption that it was written when Helen Yonge was a small child beginning a collection of pressed flowers.
